notes.title: Malazard 1.1 hotfix released
notes.notes:
[h1]The following issues have been addressed with this update.[/h1]
 [list]
    [*]The main menu buttons can be pressed again for those, who updated the Early Access version to 1.0.
    [*]The red screen effect should not get stuck after finishing a level.
[/list]
